content.text: Today marked the beginning of my journey as the Chief Executive Officer of Cisco NetConnect PUP – Manila. Stepping into this role feels both exciting and challenging, as I recognize the responsibility that comes with leading an organization and representing its members, officers, and overall vision.

During my onboarding, I took the time to understand the organization’s structure, current operations, goals, and expectations for the executive team. I also began familiarizing myself with the responsibilities of the CEO, particularly in providing strategic direction, coordinating with different departments, supporting the executive officers, and ensuring that our initiatives remain aligned with the organization’s mission.

One of my main realizations during the onboarding process is that leadership is not simply about making decisions. It is about creating an environment where people can contribute, communicate effectively, and grow. As CEO, I want to build a culture where every officer understands their responsibilities while also feeling empowered to bring their own ideas and take initiative.

Moving forward, I want to focus on establishing clear goals, strengthening collaboration between departments, and creating meaningful opportunities for our members. I understand that there will be challenges along the way, but I see this position as an opportunity to learn, serve, and help Cisco NetConnect PUP – Manila grow into a stronger organization.

This onboarding experience has given me a clearer understanding of the responsibility I have taken on. I am looking forward to working with the executive team and the entire organization, learning from every experience, and making decisions that will leave a positive impact on the organization and its members.
